faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IMSc Upper Division Clerk (UDC) post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IMSc Upper Division Clerk (UDC) post is 2 December 2026, 18:00 hours.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for the IMSc UDC recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register on the IMSc recruitment portal with your email, log in, fill the form and submit the application; a notification is then sent to your email.

faq.question: Q3. What is the advertisement number of the IMSc UDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The IMSc Upper Division Clerk (UDC) post is advertised under Advertisement No 05-R/IMSc/2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can I edit my IMSc application after submitting it?
faq.answer: No. The IMSc portal states that an application cannot be edited after final submission.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents should I keep ready before applying?
faq.answer: Keep scanned copies of your photograph, signature and certificates ready before filling the IMSc UDC online form.

faq.question: Q6. Whom do I contact for queries about the IMSc recruitment?
faq.answer: For queries other than the FAQs, email [email protected], Monday to Friday, 09:30 to 18:00.
